name: Toritsu-Daigaku
tagline: Shibuya in 12 minutes and Roppongi in 21 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Meguro City, served by Tokyu Toyoko Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 22 minutes to Shinjuku, 12 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 25.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 14.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 25.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.7 m to 38.5 m, a difference of 14.8 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 3 clinics and 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 目黒厚生会本田病院, about 2 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 日扇会第一病院, about 6 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Toyoko Line.
congestion: Tokyu Toyoko Line runs at 124% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 祐天寺→中目黒; trains from here toward 中目黒 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥270,000 to ¥280,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Midorigaoka is ahead on lower rent and the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Toritsu-Daigaku in a straight line. Toritsu-Daigaku adds the Tokyu Toyoko Line; Midorigaoka adds the Tokyu Oimachi Line. Which is faster depends on where you are going: Toritsu-Daigaku is 11 minutes quicker to Toranomon, Midorigaoka is 6 minutes quicker to Shinagawa. A one-room flat costs about ¥7,000 less at Midorigaoka. On the number of medical facilities, Midorigaoka comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Midorigaoka has 37 clinics and pharmacies and Toritsu-Daigaku has 4.

neighbours.lead: For the number of medical facilities, Jiyugaoka; for what it offers families, Toritsu-Daigaku.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Toritsu-Daigaku in a straight line. Both have the Tokyu Toyoko Line. Jiyugaoka also has the Tokyu Oimachi Line, which Toritsu-Daigaku does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On how easy the shopping is, Jiyugaoka comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Jiyugaoka has 13 supermarkets (成城石井 and Bio and others) and Toritsu-Daigaku has 6.
